project_type: TypeScript monorepo (npm workspaces): React+Vite frontend, Lambda backend, shared pure-logic lib, AWS CDK infra. Digimon-style monster raising web game for the Kiro University Challenge.
build_system: npm workspaces. Root `npm run build` compiles @ddm/shared (tsc) -> @ddm/backend (tsc) -> @ddm/frontend (tsc && vite build) -> infra (tsc), in that order. The backend/frontend import @ddm/shared via its compiled dist/, so shared MUST be rebuilt before they typecheck against new exports.
test_framework: Two separate suites. (1) @ddm/shared uses the Node built-in test runner (node:test) over packages/shared/src/__tests__/*.test.ts, baseline 47 tests. (2) Frontend pure UI helpers use node:test over packages/frontend/src/game-ui.test.ts (run via `npm run test -w @ddm/frontend` = `node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts`), baseline 33 tests. Both are dependency-free and keep DOM/React out.
test_command: npm test  (shared, 47 baseline)  AND  npm run test -w @ddm/frontend  (frontend ui-helpers, 33 baseline). Run frontend tests with env -u NODE_OPTIONS to avoid inherited flags, e.g. `cd packages/frontend && env -u NODE_OPTIONS node --experimental-strip-types --test src/game-ui.test.ts`.
verification_instructions: 1) npm run build must stay green (shared->backend->frontend->infra). 2) Both test suites must stay green and GROW (shared stays >=47, frontend grows beyond 33 with new i18n/dictionary/formatter tests). 3) Japanese output must be byte-identical to today when lang='ja' so existing JA-only assertions in game-ui.test.ts do not regress. 4) EN variant renders for every user-visible string.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None checked into source for this task. packages/*/dist and packages/frontend/dist are build artifacts (gitignored where applicable); infra/cdk.out is CDK synth output. No golden/snapshot fixtures to regenerate.
setup_instructions: npm install at repo root (done, exit 0). npm run build at repo root (done, exit 0). Node >=20.
environment_constraints: Network OPEN_INTERNET. Cannot push or open PRs (orchestrator does that). Changing packages/backend/src/handlers/chat.ts requires an AWS redeploy (cd infra && npx cdk deploy) which the ORCHESTRATOR performs after merge; the coder must NOT deploy. The baby canned reply must stay backward compatible (lang defaults to 'ja' when absent) so already-deployed backends and the frontend mirror keep working.
contribution_requirements: No external runtime dependencies may be added (no i18n library). Respect existing patterns: pure helpers in packages/frontend/src/ui-helpers.ts, CSS in packages/frontend/src/styles.css, strings tested in game-ui.test.ts. SUBMISSION.md 7-lesson + 2-bonus mapping must remain accurate; a light note for notable new files is fine but do not restructure it. Work on a feature branch off main; do NOT touch backup/previous-main branches.
key_patterns: Pure, React/DOM-free helpers live in ui-helpers.ts and are unit-tested in game-ui.test.ts. Existing localization helpers are JA-only and suffixed *Ja: stageLabelJa, winnerLabelJa, battleLogLineJa, battleLogJa, formatMinutesJa, moodLabelJa, plus BABY_SPEECH_TEXT. The battle log is a STRUCTURED ENGLISH string from @ddm/shared/battle.ts parsed by TURN_LINE_RE / RESULT_LINE_RE, so EN rendering of the log is straightforward. Enemy name is built client-side in BattlePanel.tsx as `野生の${stageLabelJa(stage)}モンスター`. Stage labels: StageConfig in packages/shared/src/stages.ts has labelJa only (幼年期/成長期/成熟期/完全体); frontend STAGE_LABELS_JA mirrors it. EN needs English stage labels (Baby/Rookie/Champion/Ultimate). evolutionProgress() in stages.ts returns nextLabelJa/currentLabelJa (JA only). ChatRequest DTO in packages/shared/src/types.ts has no lang field. buildSystemPrompt() in backend chat.ts hard-codes Japanese.
